Outcome_variable.evidence_source: [/page/13/Text/5] Time 1 SWB configurations. First, a DFA model was estimated in which four dummy codes contrasting each Time 1 SWB configuration with Time 1 cluster 5 (''low SWB'') were specified as predictors of the Time 2 SWB configurations. This model predicted accurately the Time 2 SWB configurations for 42 % of participants; Wilk's k = 0.75; v2 (16) = 126.74, p\.001. Three discriminant functions were statistically significant (ps\.004). These functions were dominated, respectively, by the Time 1 contrasts between cluster 1 (high SWB), cluster 2 (low affect) or cluster 3 (high NA) with cluster 5 (low SWB).
